description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface named TutorialRepository for the Tutorial entity, providing methods to query tutorials by published status and title.

classes.name: TutorialRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing Tutorial entities, extending JpaRepository to inherit basic CRUD operations and adding custom query methods.

methods.name: findByPublished
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tutorials filtered by their published status.

methods.name: findByTitleContaining
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tutorials where the title contains the specified substring.
